description:
List recent workspace calls, newest first.

        The list contains call summaries. ``get_call`` reads the full call and transcript.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor: the ``next_cursor`` from the previous page. Omitted: the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

limit.description: Maximum records returned on this page.
limit.title: Limit

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

status.description: Show only calls in this state now, for example ``in_progress`` for live calls or ``no_answer`` for missed ones. Omitted: all calls.
status.title: Status

to.description: Only items sent to this E.164 phone number.
to.title: To

name: list_calls

agent_id.description: Agent that answered (inbound) or placed (outbound) this call. Null when the call was placed with an inline system_prompt.
agent_id.title: Agent Id

answered_at.description: When the callee answered, ISO 8601 timestamp. Null if never answered.
answered_at.title: Answered At

direction.description: 'outbound' for calls Hail placed, 'inbound' for calls received.
direction.title: Direction

end_reason.description: Machine-readable reason the call reached a terminal status (e.g. 'normal_hangup', 'user_rejected', 'sip_trunk_failure'). Null while the call is still in progress.
end_reason.title: End Reason

ended_at.description: When the call ended, ISO 8601 timestamp. Null while still in progress.
ended_at.title: Ended At

failure_message.description: Human-readable explanation for a failed call. Null for other statuses.
failure_message.title: Failure Message

from_e164.description: Caller-id phone number used, E.164 format.
from_e164.title: From E164

initial_prompt.description: The system_prompt this call was created with, if any.
initial_prompt.title: Initial Prompt

livekit_room.description: Name of the LiveKit room hosting this call's media session, if one was created.
livekit_room.title: Livekit Room

organization_id.description: Organization that placed or received this call.
organization_id.title: Organization Id

provider_call_sid.description: The telephony provider's identifier for this call leg, if assigned.
provider_call_sid.title: Provider Call Sid

recording_duration_ms.description: Duration of captured audio, independent of billed call duration.
recording_duration_ms.title: Recording Duration Ms

recording_enabled.description: Whether the recording-enabled call rate applies, regardless of capture outcome.
recording_enabled.title: Recording Enabled

recording_s3_key.description: Internal storage key for the call recording. Not a directly fetchable URL.
recording_s3_key.title: Recording S3 Key

recording_status.description: disabled, requested, starting, recording, processing, ready, unavailable, failed, or erased.
recording_status.title: Recording Status

requested_at.description: When the call was requested, ISO 8601 timestamp.
requested_at.title: Requested At

started_at.description: When dialing began, ISO 8601 timestamp. Null until the call starts.
started_at.title: Started At

status.description: Current call-progress state: 'queued', 'dialing', 'ringing', 'in_progress', or one of the terminal states 'completed', 'failed', 'busy', 'no_answer', 'canceled'.
status.title: Status

transcript.description: What was said on the call, in the order it was said. Set only by GET /v1/calls/{call_id}: an empty list until someone speaks. Null in POST /v1/calls and GET /v1/calls responses.
transcript.title: Transcript

at.description: When the speaker started this turn, ISO 8601. When that is not known, when Hail recorded the turn.
at.title: At

role.description: 'assistant' is the Hail agent. 'user' is the person (or answering machine) on the other end of the line.
role.title: Role

text.description: What was said in this turn.
text.title: Text

items.description: Calls in this page, newest first.
items.title: Items

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Null when there are no more results.
next_cursor.title: Next Cursor

title: List calls
